title: The Last Symposium
logline: A machine at CERN retrieves nineteen canonical philosophers from history and confines them in a filmed house to draft a blueprint for the survivors of a contested civilization-ending forecast.
market: philosophical science fiction / locked-house ensemble / institutional thriller
source: Originated in ~/code/klaus/story-bible (v0.1, 2026-08-22); migrated into the press repo 2026-08-31. Sibling/adjacent premise to books/history-before-time/books/apex-alphas (different engine — see canon note) — mine for beats, do not merge the frames.
notes: Volume One 'The House of Reasons' (24 chapters, ~23k words) and Volume Two 'The Body of Evidence' (24 chapters) are both complete single-shot first drafts, not line-edited or research-cleared. Expandable series: four-volume backbone for nineteen original philosophers plus a twentieth-chair expansion hinge. No cover, no EPUB/PDF export, no build.py yet. NOT in PUBLISHED or CURATED.
